question: Q 已完整回答无候选且已测用途暂停后，是否由 Portfolio 明确可逆停放整个 ACPS，还是给出保留 ACTIVE 的实际投资理由？

changes_if_approved.target: ACPS Portfolio 生命周期（仅待 Pro 决定）
changes_if_approved.from: ACTIVE/HIGH，Q 已结束且无已选获资助的下一对象
changes_if_approved.to: DM 建议可逆 PARK；目前未应用，仍 ACTIVE/HIGH/recasts0

if_refused: Pro 可以保留 ACTIVE 并说明实际可改变决定的下一对象/投资理由及完整成本；不自动动用旧 Q 或 B02 余额。

evidence_for.quote: Apply the complete Convergence answer: no candidate; reversibly park advancement of only the exact tested ACPS package for its present fixed-budget final native-service use. Retain fully informed SHARED.
evidence_for.why: 用途节点已完成原有购买，并未选出不同用途或新的获资助对象；现在需要 Portfolio 自己决定整个方向。

evidence_against.quote: Strongest contradiction to a broad negative is the real physical/learning pathway, favorable conditional worlds and unresolved finite optimization/training-instance variation.
evidence_against.why: 专属学习在有重要资源目标时仍可能有价值；建议可逆停放而非关闭或宣称稳定损害。

uncertainty: 两次探索未证明所有实例、预算或共享机制都没有价值。
具体运行/训练资源要求或相关可靠证据可触发复审；不要求预先正向结果。

cost.compute: 本次仅 Portfolio 返回，零新实验/模型/RNG/原始分析；完整文书和 provider 成本 UNKNOWN。
cost.owner_time: 可异步介入，无需等回复。

verdict_text: DM recommendation: explicitly PARK the whole ACPS direction reversibly, retaining its evidence, informed-SHARED use advice and a concrete re-entry condition. This is a Portfolio recommendation, not an applied lifecycle change.
